adversary_model.title: Adversary model
adversary_model.description: Model for refutation passes (refute-* graph nodes; /studio:implement's halt diagnosis and pre-stage refutation). agent = each refuter runs on its own frontmatter model (default, no extra cost). fable, opus or sonnet = run refuters on that model — a stronger, independent refuter at the moments that matter; fable may bill to usage credits.
